errors.text_span: The plot illustrates the accuracy of two models, Llama4 Scout (top) and Llama4 Maverick (bottom), on 5-digit multiplication tasks
errors.evidence: The description states the plot shows two models, but there are three distinct data series (lines) shown in the figure. Furthermore, the figure does not contain a legend to support the assignment of specific lines to the named models.
The figure does not contain a legend or any labels to associate the blue line with 'Llama4 Scout'. This is an unsubstantiated mapping.
The figure does not contain a legend or any labels to associate the green line with 'Llama4 Maverick'. This is an unsubstantiated mapping.
The line style for the green line is dash-dot, not dashed.
The green line dips to a value of approximately 0.08 at an initial confidence of 0.92, not 0.15.
The green line increases to a value of approximately 0.92 at an initial confidence of 0.98, not 0.8.
